fingerprint.chooseFirst: Choose the finger to enroll first
fingerprint.confirmHint: Press the way you normally would
fingerprint.confirmTouch: Touch the sensor once to confirm
fingerprint.duplicate: This finger is already enrolled, possibly as another finger
fingerprint.fingerReady: Your %1 is ready for sudo, admin prompts and the lock screen
fingerprint.loginOnHint: Use it for sudo, admin prompts and the lock screen. Add more fingers next
fingerprint.notCentered: Center the finger on the sensor
fingerprint.passwordNeeded: Not added: your password is needed to add a fingerprint
fingerprint.pickerHint: Arrow keys and Enter, or click. Esc closes
fingerprint.placeFinger: Place the finger on the sensor
fingerprint.readerBusy: The reader is busy. Close other fingerprint tools and retry
fingerprint.readerNotStarted: The fingerprint reader could not start. Try again, or replug it
fingerprint.reenrollHint: Press Enter to enroll it again, Esc to close
fingerprint.removeAndRetry: Lift the finger, then press again
fingerprint.retryHint: Press Enter to try again, Esc to close
fingerprint.retryScan: Not a clear scan. Press flat and hold for a second
fingerprint.setupFailed: Setup failed. Check your internet connection and try again
fingerprint.stagePassed: Lift, shift the finger a little, press again
fingerprint.tooShort: Too short. Hold the finger on the sensor for a second
fingerprint.turnOnFailed: Could not turn on fingerprint login
fingerprint.turnOnHint: Press Enter to turn it on. You will be asked for your password
